content: Debriefing: Crookall - debriefing is the core of serious games; phases description, analysis/analogy, application (plus reaction/summary in other models). Schwaegele et al. 2021 Impulse-Debriefing-Spiral: short reflection impulses between rounds, not only at end. NIST SP 800-84 / CISA CTEP: hot wash immediately after exercise, data collector/scribe role, participant feedback form, AAR.
